<!--
  ui-surface — the design spec for ONE feature's surface(s): the layout intent, the fields shown,
  the actions offered, the states, and the accessibility contract. Text-first and platform-neutral.
  Lives at: `design/surfaces/<module>/<feature-slug>.md` — one page per feature, structured by named surface.
  Authorship: curated. SLO: 90d, AND stale whenever the `feature:` page or any page `flows:` names is updated
    after this one — any trigger fires. The timer stays alongside the edges: a surface spec can drift from what
    shipped even though neither the feature nor its flows has changed.
  Owner: fixed to `design`, do not substitute.
  Discipline: any visual lives in a design tool or the project's own design files (linked, never copied) — this page
    holds the STRUCTURED spec plus the pointer, never a pasted screenshot as the source of truth. Record
    that pointer in the `artifacts:` frontmatter field (a dash-list of "kind:target" entries; kind from
    the `artifact-kind` vocabulary in `wiki-page-spec`, where a `file:` entry takes a path relative to the project root to a
    file with no comment syntax and no original in a design tool; a design reference with comment
    syntax names this page with `@prototypes` instead, and an export of a tool-held frame is linked
    at the frame),
    scaffolded commented below — uncomment and fill it when a pointer exists (optional). iOS vs
    Android surface deltas are Platform-variations prose within each surface block, never separate
    pages or design systems.
  Columns: Decisions — Decision | State | Decided; Open questions — Question | Owner | Resume condition.
  Blocks: Surfaces.
  Optional: Surfaces › Platforms; Surfaces › Shown in; Surfaces › Opened from.
  Cells: Surfaces › Flow steps — flow-steps; Surfaces › Field inventory › Source — field-source;
    Surfaces › Actions › Kind — one-of primary | secondary | destructive | nav | view;
    Surfaces › Actions › Leads to — surface-link; Surfaces › Container — one-of page | dialog | panel;
    Surfaces › Platforms — platform-list; Surfaces › Node — node-refs;
    Surfaces › Shown in — surface-refs; Surfaces › Opened from — pattern-region-refs;
    Surfaces › Journey stages — journey-stages; Surfaces › Layout patterns — pattern-links.
  Extra frontmatter: `feature`, `flows`, `platforms` (any subset of web | mobile | api | email | notification | export) required;
    optional `artifacts` (design pointer, "kind:target" dash-list).
    `invalidates` (OPTIONAL) — dash-list of [[<domain>:<path>]] naming the live pages this decision
    makes partly stale; update each in the same change. Targets must be living pages — a record is
    superseded whole via `superseded-by` instead.
  Disposition: keep every header; "None." when empty; within a per-surface block, mark an
    inapplicable bullet "None." rather than deleting it — Input rules on a surface with no input,
    State transitions on a surface with one state.
  Substitute: {{TITLE}} {{DATE}} {{CONFIDENCE}} {{ORIGINATION}}.
-->

### <Surface name> (<kind>)

<!-- One sentence: what the user is doing on this surface. -->

- **Platforms** — the platforms this surface is shown on, separated by `,`: a subset of the page's
  `platforms:`, all of them when the bullet is absent. A surface that lists no screen platform
  takes "None." for Container and Node. The bullet takes no platform copy —
  [[_authoring:wiki-surface-placement-cell-grammars#surface-placement-cell-grammars]].
- **Container** — how the surface is shown: `page`, `dialog` or `panel`. A platform copy
  (`**Container (mobile)**`) overrides the shared value for that platform. "None." when the
  surface lists no screen platform —
  [[_authoring:wiki-surface-placement-cell-grammars#surface-placement-cell-grammars]].
- **Node** — where the surface sits in the sitemap: one node reference per application the surface
  is placed in, separated by `;`, each
  `[[design:information-architecture/<scope>]] <node-id>`, naming a node on an
  information-architecture page whose `platforms` covers the platform. A platform copy
  (`**Node (web)**`) overrides the shared value for that platform. A surface shown as a page on a
  platform has exactly one Node in each application there; "None." where the Container is `dialog`
  or `panel`, where the kind is `step`, or when the surface lists no screen platform —
  [[_authoring:wiki-sitemap-cell-grammars#sitemap-cell-grammars]].
- **Shown in** — the surfaces this one is shown within, as
  `[[design:surfaces/<module>/<feature-slug>#<surface-anchor>]]` links separated by `;`: for a
  region shown inside a surface's page, with Node "None.". It is placed in each application that
  surface is placed in, and sits on that surface's node. An entry may end
  `in [[design:information-architecture/<page>]]`, a scope: the entry then counts only in the
  applications that include that page. Absent or "None." otherwise. A platform copy (`**Shown in (web)**`)
  overrides the shared value for that platform —
  [[_authoring:wiki-surface-placement-cell-grammars#surface-placement-cell-grammars]].
- **Opened from** — the layout-pattern regions this surface opens from, for a dialog or panel
  opened from the page's chrome rather than from a surface, with Node "None.":
  `[[design:layout-patterns/<slug>]] <region-id>` entries separated by `;`, each with an
  optional `in [[design:information-architecture/<page>]]` scope. It is placed on each of the
  pattern's platforms, in each application whose pages cite the pattern and, when scoped,
  whose composed sitemap includes the scope's page. Absent or "None." otherwise. A platform copy
  (`**Opened from (web)**`) overrides the shared value for that platform —
  [[_authoring:wiki-surface-placement-cell-grammars#surface-placement-cell-grammars]].
- **Journey stages** — the journey stages the surface serves: "None.", or one group per journey
  separated by `;`, each the journey's `[[design:journeys/<slug>]]` link and its stage or
  opportunity ids separated by `,`. Any container or kind may serve a stage. Journey stages carry no
  platform, so this bullet takes no platform copy —
  [[_authoring:wiki-journey-cell-grammars#journey-cell-grammars]].
- **Flow steps** — the steps of the page's flows that happen here, one group per flow:
  [[product:flows/<module>/<flow-slug>]] S1, S2, E1; a step the flow marks as happening on no
  product surface may be named too, when this surface shows its progress or outcome; "None." when
  no step lands here —
  [[_authoring:wiki-surface-cell-grammars#surface-cell-grammars]].
- **Layout patterns** — the layout patterns the surface follows, as
  `[[design:layout-patterns/<slug>]]` links separated by `,`; "None." when it follows none. A
  platform copy (`**Layout patterns (web)**`) adds to the shared list for that platform; a pattern
  whose `platforms` lacks the platform, or whose `kinds` lacks the surface's kind, draws a warning —
  [[_authoring:wiki-surface-placement-cell-grammars#surface-placement-cell-grammars]].
- **Layout intent** — regions, hierarchy, what draws the eye first, density. Together with the
  Field inventory, Input rules and Actions below, this describes the surface's ideal state: full of real, useful
  content. State only what the surface adds to the layout patterns it follows. Say why the Container
  above is the right one, how inputs group
  and in what order, what is disclosed only once it becomes relevant, and how a region that scrolls
  on its own shows that it does. Narrate intent, not a
  redline dump — enough that an engineer and a reviewer agree on what the surface is. Where
  `artifacts:` records a Figma frame or a `file:` design, it is authoritative for exact spacing and
  this section need not restate it; otherwise state the spacing intent here in words, because an
  engineer building from this page has no other route to it.
- **Field inventory** — every visible field/datum, one table row each. `Source` ties the field to
  its data and opens with its kind: an entity field, [[product:entities/<module>/<entity>]] `<field>`
  or [[domain:entities/<entity>]] `<attribute>`, spelled as the entity spells it so design and build
  stay in sync; a path of them joined by ` → `; `derived from` the fields a value is computed from,
  then ` — ` and the rule; `input` for a value entered here and not stored; `static` for fixed
  interface text; `external: <system and datum>`; `system: <state>`; or `Pending: <field name>`
  where the entity is not modeled yet, with an Open questions row naming the field —
  [[_authoring:wiki-entity-cell-grammars#entity-cell-grammars]]. Labels follow the project's UX-writing standard and the design system's Voice and tone
  ([[design:design-system#voice-and-tone]]); a role-gated `Condition` links the access-model
  ([[product:concepts/access-model]] if authored; otherwise name the role in prose), the same link Actions uses.
  Or `As [[design:surfaces/<module>/<feature-slug>#<surface-anchor>]]'s.` in place of the table
  when another surface holds the same table —
  [[_authoring:wiki-section-disposition#section-disposition]].

  | Label | Source | Format | Condition (when shown) |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | <label> | <entity field / derived from … / input / static / external: … / system: … / Pending: …> | <text / currency / date / badge…> | <always / role / state> |

- **Input rules** — every input the user fills in, one table row each; "None." on a surface with
  no input. `Control` names the system's component where one exists. `Required` follows the
  `Required` column of the field's `Source` entity; raise a mismatch under Open questions rather than
  overriding it. `Validation` holds the exact rule, the message that names it (worded per the project's UX-writing
  standard), and when it is checked (on submit by default; on loss of focus only for an error-prone
  entry, with the reason); a bound-entry control (date, number, slider) needs none.
  `Help` names its tier: helper text for need-to-know guidance, placeholder for a hint or example, a
  tooltip only for extra information. Give a `Default` only where most users would choose it.
  Or `As [[design:surfaces/<module>/<feature-slug>#<surface-anchor>]]'s.` in place of the table
  when another surface holds the same table.

  | Field | Control | Required | Validation | Help | Default |
  |---|---|---|---|---|---|
  | <label> | <text input / select / date picker…> | <required / optional> | <rule → message; when checked> | <helper / placeholder / tooltip: text> | <value / —> |

- **Actions** — every action the user can take, one table row each, labeled per the project's
  UX-writing standard; a form's actions sit at its end. `Kind` is the action's effect, with at
  most one `primary` per named surface (a region with its own primary is its own named surface),
  and a platform copy of the table adds to the shared one —
  [[_authoring:wiki-surface-cell-grammars#surface-cell-grammars]]. `Precondition`
  says when the action is enabled. When a `Precondition` is a
  role/permission, link the product access-model ([[product:concepts/access-model]] if authored; otherwise name the role in prose) —
  it states who may act; the access-gated resilience state renders the denial. A `Consequence` that
  shows before the request completes says so and names the error state a failure leaves; a
  confirmation is worded per the project's UX-writing standard. `Leads to` names where the action
  leads when it succeeds — a failure stays on the surface: `—` when the user stays, `back` for
  wherever they came from, `external` for a step out of the product, a named surface as
  `[[design:surfaces/<module>/<feature-slug>#<surface-anchor>]]` (the full form, on this page too),
  or a dialog as `[[design:components/<path>]]`. A surface not specified yet is `Pending: <surface name>`,
  with an Open questions row naming it. A destination that applies only in the applications that
  include an information-architecture page carries `in [[design:information-architecture/<page>]]`
  after its platform tag. Separate several destinations with `;`, each tagged with a
  platform from the surface's own platforms, an `in [[…]]` scope or a `when <condition>` — [[_authoring:wiki-surface-cell-grammars#surface-cell-grammars]].

  | Label | Kind | Precondition | Consequence | Leads to |
  |---|---|---|---|---|
  | <label> | <primary / secondary / destructive / nav / view> | <when enabled> | <what happens> | <destination, or —> |

- **Resilience states** — loading / empty / error / partial / access-gated treatment, per
  [[product:concepts/app-ux-resilience]] (or the project's resilience standard; otherwise the five states named on this line ARE the vocabulary — the concept page only adds treatment detail). One line each;
  "None." only when a state genuinely cannot occur here. Empty names which versions occur (first
  use, user-cleared, no results), a clause each, and fills the region it replaces. Each state's message is worded per the project's UX-writing
  standard. An error never discards what the user entered.
- **State transitions** — the moves between this surface's states the user sees, one table row
  each; "None." when the surface has one state. Or
  `As [[design:surfaces/<module>/<feature-slug>#<surface-anchor>]]'s.` in place of the table
  when another surface holds the same table.

  | From | To | Trigger | What changes |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | <state> | <state> | <event> | <what the user sees change> |

- **Accessibility** — surface-specific only: color-contrast intent, focus order and the first
  input to receive focus, screen-reader labels and landmarks, what is announced as a state changes,
  format and required status stated before the user enters an input, touch-target sizing,
  motion/animation. A component's own contract lives on its `ui-component` page; general principles
  live in `concepts/`.
- **Platform variations** — per-platform deltas the coarse `platforms` enum can't carry, for THIS
  surface: responsive breakpoints, iOS vs Android control idioms, native navigation patterns, and
  how every input stays completable at the smallest supported width.
  "None." for a single-platform or single-layout surface. A delta spanning the page's surfaces goes
  in `## Platform variations` instead.

## Platform variations
<!-- Per-platform deltas that span this page's surfaces rather than belonging to one of them — a
     navigation idiom every surface inherits, a breakpoint the whole page shares. A delta local to a
     single surface stays in that surface's **Platform variations** bullet above; do not restate it
     here. "None." when every delta is surface-local, or when the page targets one platform. -->

     `[[design:studies/<slug>]]`. A call that belongs to one component goes on its `ui-component` page,
     and a navigation or route call on the `information-architecture` page. A surface decision lives
     here, not in a standalone `adr` (engineering-only). The register's states, the backing an `adopted` call names, and the `invalidates:` duty follow [[_authoring:wiki-page-state#decisions-registers]]. -->

|---|---|---|
| <the call> | proposed / adopted | |
